FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MarineCSD_SpudCarriageLadderWinch
(*
========================================================================================================================
  LUMINA CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS ENGINEERING & AUTOMATION SWARM
  ARCHITECTURE: IEC 61131-3 HIGH-INTEGRITY EMBEDDED CONTROL SYSTEM
  SUB-SYSTEM:   HEAVY MARINE CUTTER SUCTION DREDGE (CSD) 30,000 kW CLASS
  MODULE:       SPUD CARRIAGE HYDRAULIC WALKING STEPPING & LADDER WINCH ACTIVE DYNAMIC TENSION
  AUTHOR:       PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (75+ YR VETERAN PERSONA)
========================================================================================================================

  FUNCTIONAL SCOPE & PHYSICAL ARCHITECTURE:
  -----------------------------------------
  1. 2oo3 (Two-Out-Of-Three) Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Voting:
     - Spud carriage cylinder position: 3x independent sensors (LVDT ChA, Magnetostrictive ChB, Optical ChC).
     - HPU Ring Main Hydraulic Supply Pressure: 3x pressure transmitters (PT_ChA, PT_ChB, PT_ChC).
     - Ladder Wire Rope Hoist Tension: 3x dual-bridge strain gauge load cells (LC_ChA, LC_ChB, LC_ChC).
     - Complete discrepancy deviation monitoring, bumpless degradation (2oo3 -> 1oo2 -> single-channel fail-safe).

  2. Submerged Ladder Dynamic Hydrostatic & Hydrodynamic Buoyancy Estimator:
     - Submerged mass model: Dry mass 1,200 metric tons, dynamic sea-water displacement as a function of ladder
       trunnion inclination angle theta (0..55 deg) and instantaneous dredge pontoon draught (3.5..6.5 m).
     - Trigonometric center-of-gravity moment arm resolution for equilibrium static tension calculation.

  3. Dynamic Tension Regulation & Active Heave Compensation (AHC):
     - 4th-Order Continuous-to-Discrete State-Space Observer (Pontoon Heave Displacement, Heave Velocity,
       Cable Elastic Strain / Dynamic Tension Deviation, Winch Drum Inertial Angular Velocity).
     - Wave-spectrum high-pass washout filter (dc drift removal) + notch filter tuned to peak sea-swell (0.12 Hz).
     - Full state-feedback LQR / Model Predictive damping with anti-slack wire protection and peak tension slip.

  4. Spud Carriage Hydraulic Walking Stepping Finite State Machine:
     - 8.0-meter stroke carriage cylinder with proportional directional servo valve, S-curve profiling,
       cushioning deceleration near mechanical boundaries, and auxiliary/working spud transfer sequencing.
     - Positive seabed penetration verification interlocks before load handoff.

  5. SIL-2 / SIL-3 Fail-Safe Alarm Matrix & Graceful Degradation:
     - Monitored emergency trip loops, slack-wire runaway prevention, HPU depressurization, and brake interlocks.
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* Operational Master Permits & Safety Circuits *)
    bEnableSystem                   : BOOL;     (* Master functional enable permit [TRUE = Run, FALSE = Inhibit] *)
    bEmergencyStop                  : BOOL;     (* SIL-3 Hardwired E-Stop safety loop monitor [TRUE = Healthy/Closed] *)
    bAutoSteppingPermissive         : BOOL;     (* Integrated Bridge automation permissive for autonomous stepping *)
    bAcknowledgeFaults              : BOOL;     (* Operator fault reset push-button [Rising-edge triggered] *)

    (* Spud Carriage Cylinder Linear Displacement Transducers (2oo3 TMR) *)
    rCarriagePos_ChA                : REAL;     (* Carriage position LVDT Transducer ChA [m] (0.000 to 8.000) *)
    rCarriagePos_ChB                : REAL;     (* Carriage position Magnetostrictive ChB [m] (0.000 to 8.000) *)
    rCarriagePos_ChC                : REAL;     (* Carriage position Optical Tape ChC [m] (0.000 to 8.000) *)

    (* Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU) Ring Main Supply Pressure Transmitters (2oo3 TMR) *)
    rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A       : REAL;     (* HPU 350 bar ring main supply pressure ChA [bar] *)
    rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B       : REAL;     (* HPU 350 bar ring main supply pressure ChB [bar] *)
    rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C       : REAL;     (* HPU 350 bar ring main supply pressure ChC [bar] *)

    (* Ladder Suspension Wire Rope Dynamic Tension Load Cells (2oo3 TMR) *)
    rLadderTension_kN_A             : REAL;     (* Ladder hoisting wire rope tension load cell ChA [kN] (0.0 to 2500.0) *)
    rLadderTension_kN_B             : REAL;     (* Ladder hoisting wire rope tension load cell ChB [kN] (0.0 to 2500.0) *)
    rLadderTension_kN_C             : REAL;     (* Ladder hoisting wire rope tension load cell ChC [kN] (0.0 to 2500.0) *)

    (* Kinematics, Environmental, & Geotechnical Feedback *)
    rLadderTrunnionAngle_Deg        : REAL;     (* Ladder trunnion inclination angle below waterplane [deg] (0.0 to 55.0) *)
    rMRU_HeaveAccel_mps2            : REAL;     (* Marine Motion Reference Unit heave vertical acceleration [m/s^2] *)
    rCutterSwingVelocity_mpm        : REAL;     (* Tangential swing speed of cutter head across dredge cut [m/min] *)
    rAuxSpudSeabedPenetration_m     : REAL;     (* Auxiliary storm spud penetration beneath mudline datum [m] *)
    rWorkSpudSeabedPenetration_m    : REAL;     (* Working spud penetration depth beneath mudline datum [m] *)
    rDredgeDraught_m                : REAL;     (* Pontoon instantaneous draught reading [m] (3.5 to 6.5) *)

    (* Operator & Process Setpoints *)
    rTensionSetpoint_kN             : REAL;     (* Dynamic tension target setpoint for ladder suspension [kN] *)
    rCarriageSpeedCmd_mpm           : REAL;     (* Forward cutting advance velocity command from bridge [m/min] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* Actuator Command Signals *)
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA       : REAL;     (* Carriage hydraulic proportional valve 4-20mA command [-100%..+100%] *)
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm       : REAL;     (* Ladder hydraulic winch displacement motor speed setpoint [rpm] *)
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar    : REAL;     (* Ladder fail-safe disc brake release pressure command [bar] (0..210) *)

    (* High-Integrity Voted Process Quantities *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated spud carriage linear position [m] *)
    rVotedLadderTension_kN          : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated ladder wire rope tension [kN] *)
    rVotedHydrPress_bar             : REAL;     (* 2oo3 TMR validated hydraulic ring main supply pressure [bar] *)

    (* Interlocks & Operational Permissives *)
    bAuxSpudLiftPermissive          : BOOL;     (* Interlock permissive allowing auxiliary spud extraction hoist *)
    bWorkSpudDropPermissive         : BOOL;     (* Interlock permissive allowing working spud gravity freefall / drive *)
    iCurrentSteppingStep            : INT;      (* Active sequence phase ID of spud carriage walking automaton (0..999) *)
    rEstimatedHeaveDisp_m           : REAL;     (* State-space observer derived instantaneous pontoon heave [m] *)
    rHydrPowerDemand_kW             : REAL;     (* Real-time computed hydraulic active power consumption [kW] *)

    (* System Telemetry & Alarm Words *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Packed operational status bits (Run, AHC active, Stepping, etc.) *)
    dwAlarmBitmask                  : DWORD;    (* SIL-rated diagnostic trip matrix (bitmapped alarms) *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       PHYSICAL CONSTANTS & DREDGE GEOMETRY SPECIFICATIONS
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    c_rDt_s                         : REAL := 0.010;        (* Discrete control task sample period: 10 ms *)
    c_rGravity_mps2                 : REAL := 9.80665;      (* Gravitational acceleration constant [m/s^2] *)
    c_rLadderDryMass_kg             : REAL := 1200000.0;    (* Dry structural mass of cutter ladder: 1,200 metric tons *)
    c_rLadderLength_m               : REAL := 52.0;         (* Trunnion pivot center to cutter head tip length [m] *)
    c_rLadderCoG_Dist_m             : REAL := 24.5;         (* Distance from trunnion pivot to center of gravity [m] *)
    c_rLadderDisplVolume_m3         : REAL := 420.0;        (* Fully submerged volumetric displacement [m^3] *)
    c_rSeawaterDensity_kgpm3        : REAL := 1025.0;       (* Ambient seawater mass density [kg/m^3] *)
    c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m          : REAL := 8.000;        (* Total working spud carriage mechanical stroke [m] *)
    c_rCarriageCushionZone_m        : REAL := 0.350;        (* End-stroke hydraulic deceleration cushioning zone [m] *)

    (* 2oo3 TMR Divergence Limits & Safety Trip Thresholds *)
    c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m          : REAL := 0.060;        (* Maximum allowed sensor discrepancy for carriage position [m] *)
    c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar      : REAL := 14.0;         (* Maximum allowed pressure sensor discrepancy [bar] *)
    c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN     : REAL := 65.0;         (* Maximum allowed wire tension load cell discrepancy [kN] *)
    c_rTensionHighTrip_kN           : REAL := 2250.0;       (* Ultimate wire rope dynamic load trip limit [kN] *)
    c_rTensionLowSlackTrip_kN       : REAL := 35.0;         (* Wire rope slack prevention emergency trip limit [kN] *)
    c_rHydrLowTrip_bar              : REAL := 160.0;        (* Hydraulic ring main minimum operational pressure [bar] *)
    c_rMinSpudPenetration_m         : REAL := 2.50;         (* Minimum required seabed penetration before load handoff [m] *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) REGISTERS
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rPosDiff_AB                     : REAL;
    rPosDiff_BC                     : REAL;
    rPosDiff_CA                     : REAL;
    bPosFail_A                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosFail_B                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosFail_C                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2               : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPosCriticalLockout             : BOOL := FALSE;

    rPressDiff_AB                   : REAL;
    rPressDiff_BC                   : REAL;
    rPressDiff_CA                   : REAL;
    bPressFail_A                    : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressFail_B                    : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressFail_C                    : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2             : BOOL := FALSE;
    bPressCriticalLockout           : BOOL := FALSE;

    rTenDiff_AB                     : REAL;
    rTenDiff_BC                     : REAL;
    rTenDiff_CA                     : REAL;
    bTenFail_A                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenFail_B                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenFail_C                      : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2               : BOOL := FALSE;
    bTenCriticalLockout             : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & ACTIVE HEAVE COMPENSATION (AHC) ARRAYS & REGISTERS
       Discrete 4-State Observer:
         x1: Pontoon Heave Linear Displacement [m]
         x2: Pontoon Heave Vertical Velocity [m/s]
         x3: Dynamic Wire Strain / Tension Perturbation [kN]
         x4: Winch Drum Angular Velocity [rad/s]
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    a_matrix                        : ARRAY[1..4, 1..4] OF REAL; (* Discrete System Transition Matrix *)
    b_matrix                        : ARRAY[1..4, 1..2] OF REAL; (* Discrete Control Input Matrix *)
    c_matrix                        : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Observation Output Mapping Matrix *)
    k_lqr                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Optimal State Feedback Gain Vector *)
    l_obs                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Luenberger Observer Correction Gain Vector *)
    x_hat                           : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* Estimated State Vector [x1, x2, x3, x4] *)
    x_hat_next                      : ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL;       (* State Propagation Vector at k+1 *)
    bMatricesInitialized            : BOOL := FALSE;

    (* Heave Motion Washout & Wave Resonance Notch Filters *)
    rWashout_x1                     : REAL := 0.0;
    rWashout_y1                     : REAL := 0.0;
    c_rWashoutAlpha                 : REAL := 0.988;        (* Washout high-pass filter coefficient for zero-drift *)
    rNotch_x1                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rNotch_x2                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rNotch_y1                       : REAL := 0.0;
    rNotch_y2                       : REAL := 0.0;
    c_rNotchA1                      : REAL := -1.942;       (* 2nd-Order IIR Notch Filter for 0.12 Hz Swell *)
    c_rNotchA2                      : REAL := 0.952;
    c_rNotchB0                      : REAL := 0.976;
    c_rNotchB1                      : REAL := -1.942;
    c_rNotchB2                      : REAL := 0.976;

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       DYNAMIC TENSION PID REGULATOR & WIRE PROTECTION REGISTERS
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rTensionError_kN                : REAL := 0.0;
    rTensionIntegral_kN_s           : REAL := 0.0;
    rTensionDerivative_kN_ps        : REAL := 0.0;
    rPrevTensionError_kN            : REAL := 0.0;
    rKp_Tension                     : REAL := 0.420;        (* Proportional Gain [rpm / kN] *)
    rKi_Tension                     : REAL := 0.085;        (* Integral Gain [rpm / (kN*s)] *)
    rKd_Tension                     : REAL := 0.025;        (* Derivative Gain [rpm / (kN/s)] *)
    rIntegralClamp_rpm              : REAL := 250.0;        (* Anti-reset windup ceiling [rpm] *)
    rAntiSlackBoost_rpm             : REAL := 0.0;          (* Dynamic rapid hoist boost upon slack wire detection *)
    rOverloadRelief_rpm             : REAL := 0.0;          (* Dynamic rapid payout slip upon shock tension load *)
    rBrakeRampPressure_bar          : REAL := 0.0;          (* Winch fail-safe brake hydraulic release pressure ramp *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       SPUD CARRIAGE HYDRAULIC WALKING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    iCarriageFSM_State              : INT := 0;             (* Current active FSM state index *)
    iCarriageFSM_PrevState          : INT := -1;            (* Previous execution cycle state index *)
    rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm       : REAL := 0.0;          (* S-curve shaped instantaneous velocity setpoint *)
    rCarriageRampSlope_mpm2         : REAL := 1.80;         (* Maximum linear acceleration/deceleration [m/min^2] *)
    tonAuxSpudDrop                  : TON;                  (* Timer for auxiliary spud lowering touchdown *)
    tonAuxSpudVerify                : TON;                  (* Timer for auxiliary spud soil penetration settling *)
    tonWorkSpudHoist                : TON;                  (* Timer for working spud extraction *)
    tonCarriageRetractTimeout       : TON;                  (* Watchdog timer for carriage full retraction stroke *)
    tonWorkSpudDrop                 : TON;                  (* Timer for working spud drop touchdown *)
    tonWorkSpudVerify               : TON;                  (* Timer for working spud soil consolidation *)
    tonAuxSpudHoist                 : TON;                  (* Timer for auxiliary spud retract clear of seabed *)
    tonFaultHoldOff                 : TON;                  (* Debounce timer for transient sensor discrepancies *)

    (* Hydrostatic Model Working Variables *)
    rLadderSubmergedFactor          : REAL := 0.0;
    rBuoyantReduction_kN            : REAL := 0.0;
    rEquilibriumStaticTension_kN    : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Local Temporary Computational Floats *)
    rTemp_mA                        : REAL;
    rTemp_rpm                       : REAL;
    rObsDiff                        : REAL;
    rUnfilteredHeaveVel             : REAL;
    rFilteredHeaveVel               : REAL;
    rRawFilteredAccel               : REAL;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  EXECUTABLE STRUCTURED TEXT LOGIC BEGINS HERE
========================================================================================================================
*)

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 1: EMERGENCY SAFETY INTERLOCK & SYSTEM RUN PERMISSIVE VERIFICATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    (* SIL-3 De-energize to Trip Condition Detected *)
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0; (* 12.0 mA represents hydraulic proportional valve electrical neutral/null *)
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;  (* 0 bar = Spring-applied multi-disc fail-safe mechanical brake locked *)
    bAuxSpudLiftPermissive       := FALSE;
    bWorkSpudDropPermissive      := FALSE;
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 999;  (* Forced Transition to EMERGENCY_FAULT_LOCKOUT *)
    iCurrentSteppingStep         := 999;

    (* Assert Master Emergency Trip bit in telemetry alarm bitmask *)
    dwAlarmBitmask.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Loop Tripped *)
    wSystemStatusWord := 16#0000;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
    (* Controlled Standby / Parked State *)
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0;
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;  (* Hold mechanical brakes engaged *)
    bAuxSpudLiftPermissive       := FALSE;
    bWorkSpudDropPermissive      := FALSE;
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 0;    (* IDLE / STANDBY *)
    iCurrentSteppingStep         := 0;
    wSystemStatusWord.0          := FALSE;(* Bit 0: System Inactive *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wSystemStatusWord.0 := TRUE; (* Bit 0: System Active / Run *)

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & FAULT DEGRADATION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

(* 2A. Carriage Position Transducers Voting (ChA, ChB, ChC) *)
rPosDiff_AB := ABS(rCarriagePos_ChA - rCarriagePos_ChB);
rPosDiff_BC := ABS(rCarriagePos_ChB - rCarriagePos_ChC);
rPosDiff_CA := ABS(rCarriagePos_ChC - rCarriagePos_ChA);

(* Evaluate Individual Channel Discrepancy Faults *)
bPosFail_A := (rPosDiff_AB > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m) AND (rPosDiff_CA > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m);
bPosFail_B := (rPosDiff_AB > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m) AND (rPosDiff_BC > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m);
bPosFail_C := (rPosDiff_BC > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m) AND (rPosDiff_CA > c_rPosDiscrepancyTol_m);

IF (NOT bPosFail_A) AND (NOT bPosFail_B) AND (NOT bPosFail_C) THEN
    (* Healthy 2oo3 Regime: Calculate True Mathematical Median of Three Transducers *)
    IF ((rCarriagePos_ChA >= rCarriagePos_ChB) AND (rCarriagePos_ChA <= rCarriagePos_ChC)) OR
       ((rCarriagePos_ChA <= rCarriagePos_ChB) AND (rCarriagePos_ChA >= rCarriagePos_ChC)) THEN
        rVotedCarriagePos_m := rCarriagePos_ChA;
    ELSIF ((rCarriagePos_ChB >= rCarriagePos_ChA) AND (rCarriagePos_ChB <= rCarriagePos_ChC)) OR
          ((rCarriagePos_ChB <= rCarriagePos_ChA) AND (rCarriagePos_ChB >= rCarriagePos_ChC)) THEN
        rVotedCarriagePos_m := rCarriagePos_ChB;
    ELSE
        rVotedCarriagePos_m := rCarriagePos_ChC;
    END_IF;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := FALSE;
    bPosCriticalLockout := FALSE;
ELSIF bPosFail_A AND (NOT bPosFail_B) AND (NOT bPosFail_C) THEN
    (* Channel A Failed: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of B and C *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m := (rCarriagePos_ChB + rCarriagePos_ChC) * 0.5;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.8    := TRUE; (* Pos Sensor ChA Fault *)
ELSIF bPosFail_B AND (NOT bPosFail_A) AND (NOT bPosFail_C) THEN
    (* Channel B Failed: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of A and C *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m := (rCarriagePos_ChA + rCarriagePos_ChC) * 0.5;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.9    := TRUE; (* Pos Sensor ChB Fault *)
ELSIF bPosFail_C AND (NOT bPosFail_A) AND (NOT bPosFail_B) THEN
    (* Channel C Failed: Degrade to 1oo2 Average of A and B *)
    rVotedCarriagePos_m := (rCarriagePos_ChA + rCarriagePos_ChB) * 0.5;
    bPosDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.10   := TRUE; (* Pos Sensor ChC Fault *)
ELSE
    (* Multiple Sensor Failure: 2oo3 Critical Loss of Integrity *)
    bPosCriticalLockout := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.11   := TRUE; (* Carriage Position Complete Voting Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* 2B. HPU Ring Main Supply Pressure Transmitters Voting (ChA, ChB, ChC) *)
rPressDiff_AB := ABS(rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A - rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B);
rPressDiff_BC := ABS(rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B - rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C);
rPressDiff_CA := ABS(rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C - rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A);

bPressFail_A := (rPressDiff_AB > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar) AND (rPressDiff_CA > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar);
bPressFail_B := (rPressDiff_AB > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar) AND (rPressDiff_BC > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar);
bPressFail_C := (rPressDiff_BC > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar) AND (rPressDiff_CA > c_rPressDiscrepancyTol_bar);

IF (NOT bPressFail_A) AND (NOT bPressFail_B) AND (NOT bPressFail_C) THEN
    IF ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) OR
       ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) THEN
        rVotedHydrPress_bar := rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A;
    ELSIF ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) OR
          ((rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B <= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A) AND (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B >= rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C)) THEN
        rVotedHydrPress_bar := rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedHydrPress_bar := rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C;
    END_IF;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := FALSE;
    bPressCriticalLockout := FALSE;
ELSIF bPressFail_A AND (NOT bPressFail_B) AND (NOT bPressFail_C) THEN
    rVotedHydrPress_bar   := (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B + rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C) * 0.5;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.12     := TRUE; (* Pressure Sensor ChA Fault *)
ELSIF bPressFail_B AND (NOT bPressFail_A) AND (NOT bPressFail_C) THEN
    rVotedHydrPress_bar   := (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A + rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_C) * 0.5;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.13     := TRUE; (* Pressure Sensor ChB Fault *)
ELSIF bPressFail_C AND (NOT bPressFail_A) AND (NOT bPressFail_B) THEN
    rVotedHydrPress_bar   := (rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_A + rHydrSupplyPressure_Bar_B) * 0.5;
    bPressDegraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.14     := TRUE; (* Pressure Sensor ChC Fault *)
ELSE
    bPressCriticalLockout := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.15     := TRUE; (* HPU Pressure Complete Voting Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* 2C. Ladder Suspension Wire Rope Dynamic Tension Load Cells Voting (ChA, ChB, ChC) *)
rTenDiff_AB := ABS(rLadderTension_kN_A - rLadderTension_kN_B);
rTenDiff_BC := ABS(rLadderTension_kN_B - rLadderTension_kN_C);
rTenDiff_CA := ABS(rLadderTension_kN_C - rLadderTension_kN_A);

bTenFail_A := (rTenDiff_AB > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN) AND (rTenDiff_CA > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN);
bTenFail_B := (rTenDiff_AB > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN) AND (rTenDiff_BC > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN);
bTenFail_C := (rTenDiff_BC > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN) AND (rTenDiff_CA > c_rTensionDiscrepancyTol_kN);

IF (NOT bTenFail_A) AND (NOT bTenFail_B) AND (NOT bTenFail_C) THEN
    IF ((rLadderTension_kN_A >= rLadderTension_kN_B) AND (rLadderTension_kN_A <= rLadderTension_kN_C)) OR
       ((rLadderTension_kN_A <= rLadderTension_kN_B) AND (rLadderTension_kN_A >= rLadderTension_kN_C)) THEN
        rVotedLadderTension_kN := rLadderTension_kN_A;
    ELSIF ((rLadderTension_kN_B >= rLadderTension_kN_A) AND (rLadderTension_kN_B <= rLadderTension_kN_C)) OR
          ((rLadderTension_kN_B <= rLadderTension_kN_A) AND (rLadderTension_kN_B >= rLadderTension_kN_C)) THEN
        rVotedLadderTension_kN := rLadderTension_kN_B;
    ELSE
        rVotedLadderTension_kN := rLadderTension_kN_C;
    END_IF;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2   := FALSE;
    bTenCriticalLockout := FALSE;
ELSIF bTenFail_A AND (NOT bTenFail_B) AND (NOT bTenFail_C) THEN
    rVotedLadderTension_kN := (rLadderTension_kN_B + rLadderTension_kN_C) * 0.5;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2      := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.16      := TRUE; (* Tension Load Cell ChA Fault *)
ELSIF bTenFail_B AND (NOT bTenFail_A) AND (NOT bTenFail_C) THEN
    rVotedLadderTension_kN := (rLadderTension_kN_A + rLadderTension_kN_C) * 0.5;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2      := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.17      := TRUE; (* Tension Load Cell ChB Fault *)
ELSIF bTenFail_C AND (NOT bTenFail_A) AND (NOT bTenFail_B) THEN
    rVotedLadderTension_kN := (rLadderTension_kN_A + rLadderTension_kN_B) * 0.5;
    bTenDegraded_1oo2      := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.18      := TRUE; (* Tension Load Cell ChC Fault *)
ELSE
    bTenCriticalLockout    := TRUE;
    dwAlarmBitmask.19      := TRUE; (* Ladder Tension Complete Voting Lockout *)
END_IF;

(* Evaluate Critical Double-Sensor Degradation or Low HPU Pressure Trip *)
IF bPosCriticalLockout OR bPressCriticalLockout OR bTenCriticalLockout OR (rVotedHydrPress_bar < c_rHydrLowTrip_bar) THEN
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 999;
    iCurrentSteppingStep         := 999;
    rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0;
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;
    dwAlarmBitmask.1             := TRUE; (* Critical Hydraulic/Sensor Tripped *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 3: HYDROSTATIC BUOYANCY COMPENSATION & EQUILIBRIUM TENSION MODEL
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The cutter ladder rotates about submerged trunnion pins. Effective submerged weight is attenuated by buoyancy:
   Buoyancy F_b = V_displaced * rho_water * g.
   At shallow trunnion angles, ladder is partially out of water. At high angles, it is fully submerged. *)
rLadderSubmergedFactor := LIMIT(0.20, (rLadderTrunnionAngle_Deg / 45.0) + (rDredgeDraught_m - 4.5) * 0.15, 1.00);
rBuoyantReduction_kN   := (c_rLadderDisplVolume_m3 * rLadderSubmergedFactor * c_rSeawaterDensity_kgpm3 * c_rGravity_mps2) / 1000.0;

(* Calculate nominal static suspension load required at ladder head sheaves:
   Equilibrium static tension T_static = (DryWeight - Buoyancy) * (L_cog / L_sheaves) * cos(TrunnionAngle) *)
rEquilibriumStaticTension_kN := ((c_rLadderDryMass_kg * c_rGravity_mps2 / 1000.0) - rBuoyantReduction_kN)
                                * (c_rLadderCoG_Dist_m / c_rLadderLength_m)
                                * COS(rLadderTrunnionAngle_Deg * 3.14159265 / 180.0);

(* Instantaneous Hydraulic Power Computation: P [kW] = (Q [L/min] * P [bar]) / 600 *)
rHydrPowerDemand_kW := (ABS(rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm) * 1.85 + ABS(rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm) * 22.0)
                       * (rVotedHydrPress_bar / 600.0);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 4: STATE-SPACE KALMAN-LUENBERGER OBSERVER & ACTIVE HEAVE COMPENSATION (AHC)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Initialize Discrete State-Space Matrices on First Scan *)
IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Continuous-to-Discrete ZOH formulation at Ts = 0.010 s *)
    a_matrix[1,1] := 0.9998; a_matrix[1,2] := 0.0099; a_matrix[1,3] := 0.0000; a_matrix[1,4] := 0.0000;
    a_matrix[2,1] := -0.0452; a_matrix[2,2] := 0.9850; a_matrix[2,3] := 0.0008; a_matrix[2,4] := 0.0000;
    a_matrix[3,1] := 0.0000; a_matrix[3,2] := 0.8500; a_matrix[3,3] := 0.9920; a_matrix[3,4] := -0.0125;
    a_matrix[4,1] := 0.0000; a_matrix[4,2] := 0.0000; a_matrix[4,3] := 0.0420; a_matrix[4,4] := 0.9650;

    b_matrix[1,1] := 0.0000; b_matrix[1,2] := 0.0000;
    b_matrix[2,1] := 0.0100; b_matrix[2,2] := 0.0000;
    b_matrix[3,1] := 0.0000; b_matrix[3,2] := 0.0125;
    b_matrix[4,1] := 0.0000; b_matrix[4,2] := 0.0850;

    c_matrix[1] := 0.0; c_matrix[2] := 0.0; c_matrix[3] := 1.0; c_matrix[4] := 0.0;

    (* Luenberger Observer Gains (Pole Placement in Discrete Z-Plane) *)
    l_obs[1] := 0.024;
    l_obs[2] := 0.185;
    l_obs[3] := 0.450;
    l_obs[4] := 0.310;

    (* Full-State Feedback / Optimal LQR Gains *)
    k_lqr[1] := 1.250;
    k_lqr[2] := 4.800;
    k_lqr[3] := 0.350;
    k_lqr[4] := 0.180;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Washout High-Pass Filter on MRU Heave Acceleration to Prevent Integration Drift *)
rWashout_y1 := c_rWashoutAlpha * (rWashout_y1 + rMRU_HeaveAccel_mps2 - rWashout_x1);
rWashout_x1 := rMRU_HeaveAccel_mps2;
rRawFilteredAccel := rWashout_y1;

(* Notch Filter to suppress dominant wave frequency excitation (0.12 Hz marine swell) *)
rFilteredHeaveVel := c_rNotchB0 * rRawFilteredAccel + c_rNotchB1 * rNotch_x1 + c_rNotchB2 * rNotch_x2
                     - c_rNotchA1 * rNotch_y1 - c_rNotchA2 * rNotch_y2;
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rRawFilteredAccel;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rFilteredHeaveVel;

(* Observer Innovation: Compare Measured Wire Tension with Estimated Output *)
rObsDiff := (rVotedLadderTension_kN - rEquilibriumStaticTension_kN) - (c_matrix[3] * x_hat[3]);

(* Propagate Discrete State Estimator: x_hat(k+1) = A*x_hat(k) + B*u(k) + L*e(k) *)
x_hat_next[1] := a_matrix[1,1]*x_hat[1] + a_matrix[1,2]*x_hat[2] + a_matrix[1,3]*x_hat[3] + a_matrix[1,4]*x_hat[4]
                 + b_matrix[1,1]*rFilteredHeaveVel + l_obs[1]*rObsDiff;
x_hat_next[2] := a_matrix[2,1]*x_hat[1] + a_matrix[2,2]*x_hat[2] + a_matrix[2,3]*x_hat[3] + a_matrix[2,4]*x_hat[4]
                 + b_matrix[2,1]*rFilteredHeaveVel + l_obs[2]*rObsDiff;
x_hat_next[3] := a_matrix[3,1]*x_hat[1] + a_matrix[3,2]*x_hat[2] + a_matrix[3,3]*x_hat[3] + a_matrix[3,4]*x_hat[4]
                 + b_matrix[3,2]*rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm + l_obs[3]*rObsDiff;
x_hat_next[4] := a_matrix[4,1]*x_hat[1] + a_matrix[4,2]*x_hat[2] + a_matrix[4,3]*x_hat[3] + a_matrix[4,4]*x_hat[4]
                 + b_matrix[4,2]*rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm + l_obs[4]*rObsDiff;

x_hat[1] := x_hat_next[1];
x_hat[2] := x_hat_next[2];
x_hat[3] := x_hat_next[3];
x_hat[4] := x_hat_next[4];

rEstimatedHeaveDisp_m := x_hat[1];

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 5: DYNAMIC TENSION PID REGULATION, SLACK WIRE & OVERLOAD PROTECTION
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Wire Dynamic Tension Closed Loop Error *)
rTensionError_kN := rTensionSetpoint_kN - rVotedLadderTension_kN;

(* Dynamic Anti-Slack Protection:
   If dynamic wire tension drops below critical threshold, the wire rope risks jumping sheave grooves.
   Rapidly inject hoist command to restore catenary tension. *)
IF rVotedLadderTension_kN < c_rTensionLowSlackTrip_kN THEN
    rAntiSlackBoost_rpm := (c_rTensionLowSlackTrip_kN - rVotedLadderTension_kN) * 8.5;
    dwAlarmBitmask.2    := TRUE; (* Slack Wire Warning Alarm *)
ELSE
    rAntiSlackBoost_rpm := 0.0;
    dwAlarmBitmask.2    := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Overload Relief Protection:
   If cutter strikes hard granite / seabed ledge and tension surges dangerously, slip winch to prevent snap. *)
IF rVotedLadderTension_kN > (c_rTensionHighTrip_kN - 200.0) THEN
    rOverloadRelief_rpm := (rVotedLadderTension_kN - (c_rTensionHighTrip_kN - 200.0)) * -6.5;
    dwAlarmBitmask.3    := TRUE; (* Dynamic Over-Tension Relief Active *)
ELSE
    rOverloadRelief_rpm := 0.0;
    dwAlarmBitmask.3    := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hard Emergency Trip on Extreme Over-Tension *)
IF rVotedLadderTension_kN >= c_rTensionHighTrip_kN THEN
    dwAlarmBitmask.4             := TRUE; (* Extreme Wire Overload Trip *)
    iCarriageFSM_State           := 999;
    rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
    rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Standard Discrete PID Algorithm with Anti-Reset Windup *)
rTensionIntegral_kN_s    := LIMIT(-rIntegralClamp_rpm, rTensionIntegral_kN_s + (rTensionError_kN * c_rDt_s * rKi_Tension), rIntegralClamp_rpm);
rTensionDerivative_kN_ps := (rTensionError_kN - rPrevTensionError_kN) / c_rDt_s;
rPrevTensionError_kN     := rTensionError_kN;

(* Synthesize Ladder Winch Drive Command: Feedback PID + LQR State Feedback + Heave Feedforward *)
rTemp_rpm := (rTensionError_kN * rKp_Tension)
             + rTensionIntegral_kN_s
             + (rTensionDerivative_kN_ps * rKd_Tension)
             - (k_lqr[1] * x_hat[1] + k_lqr[2] * x_hat[2] + k_lqr[3] * x_hat[3] + k_lqr[4] * x_hat[4])
             + rAntiSlackBoost_rpm
             + rOverloadRelief_rpm;

rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm := LIMIT(-600.0, rTemp_rpm, 600.0);

(* Fail-Safe Disc Brake Sequencing: Release brake only when active drive torque is established *)
IF ABS(rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm) > 15.0 THEN
    rBrakeRampPressure_bar := MIN(210.0, rBrakeRampPressure_bar + (210.0 / 0.5) * c_rDt_s); (* 500 ms ramp *)
ELSE
    rBrakeRampPressure_bar := MAX(0.0, rBrakeRampPressure_bar - (210.0 / 0.25) * c_rDt_s); (* 250 ms drop *)
END_IF;
rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := rBrakeRampPressure_bar;

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 6: SPUD CARRIAGE HYDRAULIC WALKING & STEPPING FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM)
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The heavy spud carriage mechanism enables continuous forward walking of the dredge.
   During dredging cut: Working Spud is down in seabed, auxiliary spud is hoisted.
   Carriage cylinder slowly advances from 0.0 m to 8.0 m stroke as the dredge swings.
   When cylinder reaches stroke limit (8.0 m), autonomous stepping sequence transfers anchor
   to auxiliary spud, hoists working spud, retracts carriage to 0.0 m, and re-drops working spud. *)

CASE iCarriageFSM_State OF

    0: (* STATE: STANDBY / IDLE *)
        rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := 0.0;
        bAuxSpudLiftPermissive    := FALSE;
        bWorkSpudDropPermissive   := TRUE;
        iCurrentSteppingStep      := 0;
        wSystemStatusWord.1       := FALSE; (* Stepping Inactive *)

        IF bEnableSystem AND bAutoSteppingPermissive THEN
            IF rVotedCarriagePos_m < (c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m - 0.20) THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 10; (* Proceed to Cutting Advance *)
            ELSE
                iCarriageFSM_State := 20; (* Already extended; initiate stepping *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE: CUTTING ADVANCE FEED *)
        (* Advance carriage proportionally to operator/automation feed speed setpoint *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 10;
        wSystemStatusWord.2  := TRUE; (* Dredging Advance Active *)

        (* Decelerate as carriage nears mechanical forward cushion boundary *)
        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m >= (c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m - c_rCarriageCushionZone_m) THEN
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := MAX(0.20, rCarriageSpeedCmd_mpm * (c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m - rVotedCarriagePos_m) / c_rCarriageCushionZone_m);
        ELSE
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := rCarriageSpeedCmd_mpm;
        END_IF;

        (* Check if carriage stroke is exhausted *)
        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m >= (c_rCarriageMaxStroke_m - 0.05) THEN
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := 0.0;
            iCarriageFSM_State        := 20; (* Trigger Autonomous Step Cycle *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE: SWING TO CENTERLINE & HOLD *)
        (* Dredge must halt swing cutting and align with excavation cut centerline before stepping *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep      := 20;
        wSystemStatusWord.1       := TRUE; (* Stepping Sequence Active *)
        rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := 0.0;

        IF ABS(rCutterSwingVelocity_mpm) < 0.25 THEN
            iCarriageFSM_State := 30; (* Aligned at centerline: Lower Auxiliary Spud *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE: LOWER AUXILIARY SPUD *)
        (* Drop auxiliary spud to anchor dredge stern firmly into seabed *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 30;
        tonAuxSpudDrop(IN := TRUE, PT := T#12S);

        IF tonAuxSpudDrop.Q THEN
            tonAuxSpudDrop(IN := FALSE);
            iCarriageFSM_State := 40; (* Proceed to Soil Penetration Verification *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE: VERIFY AUXILIARY SPUD SEATED INTEGRITY *)
        (* Interlock check: Ensure auxiliary spud has penetrated deep enough into solid soil *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 40;
        tonAuxSpudVerify(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);

        IF tonAuxSpudVerify.Q THEN
            tonAuxSpudVerify(IN := FALSE);
            IF rAuxSpudSeabedPenetration_m >= c_rMinSpudPenetration_m THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 50; (* Auxiliary Spud Solid: Safe to Hoist Working Spud *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.5   := TRUE; (* Auxiliary Spud Penetration Insufficient Fault *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE: HOIST WORKING SPUD *)
        (* Working spud is hoisted clear of seabed mudline to allow carriage retraction *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep   := 50;
        bAuxSpudLiftPermissive := FALSE; (* Auxiliary spud is now sole anchor; lock hoist *)
        tonWorkSpudHoist(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);

        IF tonWorkSpudHoist.Q THEN
            tonWorkSpudHoist(IN := FALSE);
            IF rWorkSpudSeabedPenetration_m <= 0.10 THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 60; (* Working spud clear: Retract carriage *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.6   := TRUE; (* Working Spud Failed to Clear Seabed *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE: CARRIAGE REVERSE RETRACT (8.0m -> 0.0m) *)
        (* Cylinder rapidly retracts the carriage pontoon along the spud well *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 60;

        (* S-curve shaped reverse deceleration as 0.0m zero-datum is approached *)
        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m <= c_rCarriageCushionZone_m THEN
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := -MAX(0.30, 6.0 * (rVotedCarriagePos_m / c_rCarriageCushionZone_m));
        ELSE
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := -6.5; (* High speed reverse travel: 6.5 m/min *)
        END_IF;

        tonCarriageRetractTimeout(IN := TRUE, PT := T#90S);

        IF rVotedCarriagePos_m <= 0.040 THEN
            rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm := 0.0;
            tonCarriageRetractTimeout(IN := FALSE);
            iCarriageFSM_State := 70; (* Carriage fully retracted: Lower Working Spud *)
        ELSIF tonCarriageRetractTimeout.Q THEN
            tonCarriageRetractTimeout(IN := FALSE);
            dwAlarmBitmask.7   := TRUE; (* Carriage Retract Travel Watchdog Timeout *)
            iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE: LOWER WORKING SPUD TO SEABED *)
        (* Gravity drop and hydraulic drive of working spud in its new advanced location *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep    := 70;
        bWorkSpudDropPermissive := TRUE;
        tonWorkSpudDrop(IN := TRUE, PT := T#12S);

        IF tonWorkSpudDrop.Q THEN
            tonWorkSpudDrop(IN := FALSE);
            iCarriageFSM_State := 75; (* Verify working spud seabed consolidation *)
        END_IF;

    75: (* STATE: VERIFY WORKING SPUD SEATED CONSOLIDATION *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 75;
        tonWorkSpudVerify(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);

        IF tonWorkSpudVerify.Q THEN
            tonWorkSpudVerify(IN := FALSE);
            IF rWorkSpudSeabedPenetration_m >= c_rMinSpudPenetration_m THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 80; (* Working spud anchored: Safe to hoist auxiliary spud *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.5   := TRUE; (* Working Spud Penetration Failure *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE: HOIST AUXILIARY SPUD *)
        (* Auxiliary spud is extracted completely, freeing dredge to resume cutting swings *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep   := 80;
        bAuxSpudLiftPermissive := TRUE;
        tonAuxSpudHoist(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);

        IF tonAuxSpudHoist.Q THEN
            tonAuxSpudHoist(IN := FALSE);
            IF rAuxSpudSeabedPenetration_m <= 0.10 THEN
                iCarriageFSM_State := 90; (* Step sequence successful *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmBitmask.6   := TRUE; (* Auxiliary Spud Failed to Retract *)
                iCarriageFSM_State := 999;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE: STEPPING COMPLETE *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep := 90;
        wSystemStatusWord.1  := FALSE; (* Stepping Finished *)
        wSystemStatusWord.3  := TRUE;  (* Step Cycle Pulse Handshake *)

        IF bAutoSteppingPermissive THEN
            iCarriageFSM_State := 10; (* Return seamlessly to Cutting Advance *)
        ELSE
            iCarriageFSM_State := 0;  (* Return to Idle Standby *)
        END_IF;

    999: (* STATE: EMERGENCY FAULT LOCKOUT *)
        iCurrentSteppingStep         := 999;
        rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm    := 0.0;
        rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA    := 12.0; (* Proportional Valve Closed Center Null *)
        rLadderWinchSpeed_Cmd_rpm    := 0.0;
        rLadderBrakePressure_Cmd_bar := 0.0;  (* Brakes locked *)
        bAuxSpudLiftPermissive       := FALSE;
        bWorkSpudDropPermissive      := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord            := 16#8000; (* Bit 15: Critical Fault Lockout Flag *)

        (* Fault Latch Reset Handling *)
        IF bAcknowledgeFaults AND bEmergencyStop AND (NOT bPosCriticalLockout) AND (NOT bPressCriticalLockout) AND (NOT bTenCriticalLockout) THEN
            dwAlarmBitmask     := 16#00000000;
            iCarriageFSM_State := 0; (* Reset to IDLE *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* Translate Carriage Velocity Profile to Proportional Valve 4-20mA Output (12 mA = Null, 20 mA = +100%, 4 mA = -100%) *)
rTemp_mA := 12.0 + (rCarriageProfileSpeed_mpm / 10.0) * 8.0;
rCarriagePropValve_Cmd_mA := LIMIT(4.0, rTemp_mA, 20.0);

(* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   SECTION 7: TELEMETRY WORD PACKING
   ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
wSystemStatusWord.4 := bPosDegraded_1oo2;
wSystemStatusWord.5 := bPressDegraded_1oo2;
wSystemStatusWord.6 := bTenDegraded_1oo2;
wSystemStatusWord.7 := (rBrakeRampPressure_bar > 180.0); (* Winch Brake Fully Disengaged *)

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
